description: An asm program links an asm shared library: the build puts each RID's library next to its program with the run path that finds it, dotnet run starts this machine's build, and dotnet publish -r publishes the program with its library, which runs from there.

steps.description: Builds the library and the program for all eight RIDs; each program folder gets its library.
Starts this machine's build: exit status 42 is calc_mul(6, 7), from the library.

steps.description: Publishes this machine's build with the library it links.
